concept_decisions: Retain concept branching channel network, long unequal tide-aligned bars, open seaward mouths and shallow relief. Correct overly raised banks and narrow uniform river-like branches: major downstream channel width must flare visibly. Avoid disconnected decorative bars and surface coplanarity. Water volume terminates at designed shoreline, not overlapping exposed land surfaces. At least two branching tidal side creeks connect into distributaries. Primary actual Fly photo has forested islands; vegetation omitted and no ecosystem claimed.
